routes.target: Conditional row-density extraction for K=Q(sqrt(-3)): sum_{0<N(u)<=H}|sum_{(n,S)=1}mu_K(n)nu(n)rho_n(u)W(N(n)/D)|^2 << D^(1+epsilon)H, with rho_n(p^k)=1_{p does not divide n}; RH endpoint would require a valid prime-density (k=1) family and the estimate for some H=D^h, h>=1/2. Such a nontrivial character family and estimate are not supplied.
routes.coefficient_convention: Ideal Mobius coefficients on K, ideals prime to fixed S; no ordinary/Jensen Taylor coefficients. D is ideal-norm sum length, H is family norm cutoff, Y=H^(1/k).
routes.dh_analogue: The DH reciprocal coefficients b=a^{-1} can be used in a smoothed cancellation statement or lifted by ideal norm. A square-root bound for every W would contradict DH zeros with Re(s)>1. The actual b is not multiplicative, even away from 2,3,5; it cannot be identified with ideal-Mobius/finite-order-Hecke coefficients. A replacement DH metaplectic family remains uninstantiated.

failure.classical_reference: Titchmarsh, second edition, section 10.25: infinitely many DH zeros with Re(s)>1; exact reference retained in quasi_rh_seven_eighths.

routes.arithmetic_property: Ideal-Mobius/finite-order-Hecke multiplicativity plus the exact identity mu_K*gamma_{-1}=chi(-1)*G^{-1}*bar(alpha)*gamma_2, cubic-theta reflection and cube inversion. The DH identification fails algebraically; these properties do not by themselves prove a short-family mean square.
routes.separating_inequality: Unproved coefficient-specific MS(D,H) << D^(1+epsilon)H with an actually defined extraction family. Under its hypotheses sigma_k(h)=max(1/2+h(k-1)/(2k),1-h/k), global infimum k/(k+1); the h>1 infimum is 1-1/(2k). For k=1 all h>=1/2 attain 1/2, and the literal order-one residue family is principal.
routes.gap: The unchanged cubic substitution fails: p^3 is quadratic in the sextic family; changing to cubic twists produces bar(alpha)*gamma_2^2=bar(alpha)*G^{-1}*gamma_1, a sextic Gauss coefficient rather than the existing ordinary cubic-theta coefficient. The ordinary-theta j=2 reflection would remain cubic, losing the quadratic sieve. Sixth-cover fourth-power coefficient relations require a new index/completion/cost argument; a valid short-family range is also missing. At k=3 the existing h>1 range would yield 5/6, not 3/4.
routes.scope: A checked structural arithmetic separator and conditional optimization, not a proved RH-level mean square, RH strategy, new zero-free theorem or Lean result.
